The query "when did channel 5 start" can refer to different stations. Within the scope of the British Channel 5, multiple sources confirm it launched on 30 March 1997 at 6pm [d1][d2][d6][d9]. The launch featured the Spice Girls performing a cover of Manfred Mann's "5-4-3-2-1," with presenters Tim Vine and Julia Bradbury introducing the UK's fifth terrestrial channel [d2][d9][d4]. A few weeks later, on 23 April 1997, Channel 5 also launched on satellite to reach the third of UK homes that could not receive the terrestrial signal [d1][d6].
